text: This newly renovated clinic has a great dentist who provides excellent advice and does good dental work. It's a small clinic with not many patients, so the wait time is short. I came here today for teeth cleaning; the price is reasonable. You can call to inquire beforehand. The assistants are helpful. There's parking available in front of the clinic, located on the main road near The Mall Bangkapi, making it easy to get to.
